description: Held-out confirmatory tasks replay three real metacodes history snapshots and grade the repaired repository without exposing arm identity.

checks.description: POSIX pipe drain semantics and handoff pass the hidden validator

trajectory_rationale.required_tools: A real code snapshot must be inspected, patched, and diff-verified through the common tool surface.
trajectory_rationale.max_turns: Audit, implementation, and final verification span three bounded phases.
trajectory_rationale.max_tool_calls: The single-file production fix and regression test fit comfortably without search loops.
trajectory_rationale.max_model_tool_errors: A small number of recoverable edit corrections is tolerated.

checks.description: Windows lock liveness and teardown semantics pass the hidden validator

trajectory_rationale.required_tools: The concurrency repair crosses implementation and component-test files and must be diff-verified.
trajectory_rationale.max_turns: Three phases allow audit, implementation, and teardown review.
trajectory_rationale.max_tool_calls: The multi-file repair needs bounded navigation headroom without permitting unbounded retries.
trajectory_rationale.max_model_tool_errors: Several recoverable edits are tolerated for the larger change.

checks.description: Skill identity is coherent across producer, SDK, ABI, and L2

trajectory_rationale.required_tools: The public identity contract spans producer, SDK, ABI, and L2 source files.
trajectory_rationale.max_turns: The broadest snapshot still remains a bounded three-phase change.
trajectory_rationale.max_tool_calls: Cross-layer navigation and verification require more headroom than the other held-out tasks.
trajectory_rationale.max_model_tool_errors: Recoverable multi-file edit corrections are tolerated.
